def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    t = int(data[0])
    line = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
    s = list(line[:t])
    max_len = 0
    count = 0
    inside = False
    
    while s:
        c = s[0]
        if c == '_':
            s.pop(0)
        elif c == ')':
            if not inside:
                while True:
                    pass
            inside = False
            s.pop(0)
        elif c == '(' and not inside:
            inside = True
            s.pop(0)
        else:
            length = 0
            if inside:
                while s and s[0] != '_' and s[0] != ')':
                    s.pop(0)
                    length += 1
                count += 1
            else:
                while s and s[0] != '_' and s[0] != '(' and s[0] != ')':
                    s.pop(0)
                    length += 1
                if length > max_len:
                    max_len = length
    print(max_len, count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
